reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent source-semantic review against the live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP view of retail igi.exe (entry 0x004A50F5) and Radare2 6.2.0; the retail bytes were read directly and the candidate translation unit was read at its recorded digest.
source_revision: worktree branch 3a26bb23; implementation bound by engine/src/retail/core/app_context.cpp sha256 b6ba8b5b6d1e337910c59bc20ee7a50299013b9b50cbf14f7e0f235aa0037823
review_basis: The retail entry was re-read through the live Binary Ninja MCP view and independently recovered with Radare2; both graphs are recorded in the referenced evidence files and agree on nodes and edges. The candidate body was then compared against the retail instructions and the recorded retail bytes.

retail_function.name: AppContext_SetLightmapsUsed
retail_function.summary: App_ContextSetLightmapsUsed(): stores the sign-extended low byte of its argument into the 32-bit lightmaps-used field of the port app-context state and returns the stored value.

candidate_function.summary: App_ContextSetLightmapsUsed(): stores the sign-extended low byte of its argument into the 32-bit lightmaps-used field of the port app-context state and returns the stored value.

signature_comparison.rationale: Retail reads one 4-byte stack argument as a signed byte (movsx eax, byte [esp+0x4]), stores the sign-extended dword and returns it in EAX; Radare2 records nargs=1, cdecl, int8_t arg_4h. The candidate takes std::int8_t, stores the same sign-extended 32-bit value and returns it, preserving the argument slot and cdecl. The original source return type is unknown; the retained Ghidra void inference is a conflicting note, and the candidate's int32_t return preserves the observed EAX value.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Binary Ninja and Radare2 both recover the exact entry 0x0048F240 as one 11-byte basic block with 0 edges (CFG node/edge sets identical, recorded score 1.000). Binary Ninja names it AppContext_SetLightmapsUsed and its analyst comment documents the object-lightmap setter; the candidate defines App_ContextSetLightmapsUsed as the body implementing that entry.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: Retail reads one 4-byte stack argument at [esp+0x4] as a signed byte (`movsx eax, byte [esp+0x4]`); Radare2 records nargs=1, cdecl, int8_t arg_4h. The candidate takes std::int8_t used, sign-extends it to the 32-bit field and preserves the argument slot and cdecl.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: The only constant is the retail global address 0x005C8BE4, mapped to the named port field app_context_state.lightmaps_used. The sign extension is reproduced by static_cast<std::int32_t>(std::int8_t), not by an invented scale or mask.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: Retail bytes 0f be 44 24 04 a3 e4 8b 5c 00 c3 are `movsx eax, byte [esp+0x4]; mov dword [0x5c8be4], eax; retn`: one 1-byte read and one 32-bit store. The candidate reads the same argument width and performs the same 32-bit store to the port-owned field.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: No call exists in either body. There is exactly one side effect, the 32-bit store to the lightmaps-used flag, and the candidate reproduces it. The previous review's runtime_contract asserted no_side_effects=true for this store; that claim was wrong and the contract has been removed rather than rebound.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: Retail leaves the stored (sign-extended) value in EAX, so the setter returns the value it wrote; the candidate returns the same value. No error path exists in either body. The retail source return type is unknown; the candidate's int32_t return preserves the observed EAX.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: Neither the 11-byte retail body nor the candidate contains an x87 instruction or any floating-point value.

limitations: No live paired runtime capture exists; the differential is Unicorn plus the compiled candidate.
The CFG agreement cited here is Binary Ninja vs Radare2 on the retail image; angr CFGFast was not rerun for this rebind.
cfg_similarity 1.0 is not a candidate-vs-retail CFG score; the candidate machine CFG was not compared for isomorphism.
The previous runtime_contract (typed-per-native-probe, no_side_effects=true) was inaccurate for a setter that stores to 0x005C8BE4 and was removed; no paired probe exists for this address.
